name: Task → Google Calendar block
description: Linear issue pages get a 📅 Block time button (or Option+B); Reclaim's Planner gets a 📅 Block action on task rows, a ↗ link on task events, a ＋ to link or create a Linear issue and a ⚡ energy badge on Linear-linked events. The 📅 buttons open a prefilled Google Calendar event; the optional Linear API key is sent only to api.linear.app.
